title: JIM SHORE MASTERPIECE SANTA SL...
reason: Boxed Jim Shore Heartwood Creek Masterpiece Santa Sleigh, a large collectable with a wind-up mechanism, likely worth well over $100 and possibly a few hundred.
findings: Box reads Jim Shore, Heartwood Creek, 'To All A Merry Night', Masterpiece Santa Sleigh, with matching artwork and an Armitage lot sticker 275, so the original packaging claim is supported. The figure looks complete: Santa in a green and red sleigh with a toy sack and toy soldier, a team of about eight reindeer in flight on a rod, a translucent yellow moon backdrop, a snowy townscape base with the Jim Shore folk art border (holly, pine cones, baubles) and a round painted key knob at the right end of the base, which suggests a wind-up musical or moving mechanism. One photo shows the printed insert with Jim Shore's portrait and logo. The small text on the box side panel and any item number are not legible, and no base mark is visible. Value judged from general knowledge only (web search was not available): large Jim Shore Masterpiece pieces sell new for a few hundred dollars.
condition: Figure looks complete and undamaged in the photos, antlers, harness and wires intact. Box shows only light wear. Working order of the mechanism is not shown and untested.
rescore_note: Boxed Jim Shore Heartwood Creek Masterpiece Santa Sleigh, complete and undamaged in the photos with a wind-up key; a large flagship piece from a popular brand, held back by an untested mechanism, a fragile bulky item to ship, and no comparables checked (search budget used up).
